dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Well, since you asked, I have an idea for a flamestrider Grand Prix!

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Hahaha, I've been thinking about it ever since I arrived! It would be a shame not to take advantage of all this space and the amazing scenery.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: So, this is what I was thinking... We create a race track that combines speed and technique and invite challengers to compete. The winner can be crowned the "Master of the Striding Flame."

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: If the tournament is a success, it would bring in a significant profit, in which case, you wouldn't need to worry about future prizes, and you could even expand the scale.

choices.text: I see where you're coming from, but...

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: Oh, don't worry. I already asked Xilonen about that. Although, she categorically refused...

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: I understand her reasoning, of course. I would need at least eight flamestriders, which would cost a small fortune, and I have no idea where we would find enough Secret Source components.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: Still, having a vision is better than nothing. Besides, I have a back-up plan that only involves one rider.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: Instead of having everyone ride a flamestrider at once, everyone will take turns with mine, and the person with the fastest time wins.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: Of course, Xilonen rejected this proposal as well. The reason being, the flamestrider was originally designed for battle and travel, rather than speed.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: Several modifications would need to be made to operate at high speeds, which means faster wear and tear, and more maintenance.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: In short, we cannot sacrifice the core function of the flamestrider for our own entertainment.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: But, that also means... We could just design a new flamestrider built entirely for speed!

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: I'll make a quick sketch and show it to Xilonen right away!

choices.text: Do you have enough flamestriders for that?
